summary: The diff matches the spec in all 6 files and makes no src/** change. The lint config adds LINT_ONLY_HEADLESS_DIRS exactly as designed, and HEADLESS_DIRS is unchanged, so the locked coverage test is untouched. SPEC-01 uses awards with pot index 1 and orders [A,B] and [B,A,C], so the last-hand, first-hand, pot-index-sum and single-largest-award mutants all fail. SPEC-02 recomputes from totalContribution and asserts that expected > 0 and that the last hand's pot is below expected, so it cannot pass vacuously. SPEC-03 checks the exact sorted per-seat factory calls and decisions >= 2 per hand, and 12 distinct calls across 3 hands, so it catches both per-decision and per-run policy creation. SPEC-04/05 run one sandbox lint and check, under each file's stylish header block, all three restricted-import lines with REQ-059.2. NEW_DIRS is written out on purpose instead of importing LINT_ONLY_HEADLESS_DIRS, so it is not a tautology. SPEC-06: the grep finds nothing and lint exits 0. I re-ran the 4 affected test files (11 tests passed) and npm run lint (exit 0). The gate build-1 passed. No findings.
